verdict.rationale: Poly is documented as a cloud file-storage service: the sync folder downloads files on demand and syncs back to Poly's storage, and MCP connects to the vendor-hosted mcp.poly.app endpoint. Offline pinning and a sync queue that survives restarts are adjacent features that cache cloud-owned data; they are not a local-only mode. The pack has no evidence of a local-only mode or a self-hostable sync backend.
